name: Geometry Clipmap for LOD Rendering
definition: A rendering approach using cubical shells (world octants of LOD grids) around the viewer to render distant meshes with fewer vertices (higher LOD).
summary: Geometry Clipmap for LOD Rendering is a real-time volumetric terrain technique using 3D cubical shells to reduce distant vertex counts, distinctively operating on 2D heightmaps rather than complex 3D mesh topologies.
